Product Profile
CR Dhan 102, also known as Santha Bhima, is a 110-day variety released by ICAR-NRRI in 2020. Featuring medium height and short bold grains, it is ideally suited for upland ecosystems prone to recurrent water deficits. Notably, CR Dhan 102 demonstrates tolerance against major diseases and pests. The average grain yield of this variety stands at 3.9 tons per hectare.
